name: When You're Here
source:
As a first-year college student, Neo's life seemed to be going well until suddenly one day, on a hot summer day, he met someone who wasn't human. He decided to lend a hand, and his life took an unexpected turn! Now, with mystical magical powers in the mix, Neo must assist his new friend.

[Edited from [url=https://stampaw.itch.io/when-you-are-here]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学一年级学生Neo原本过得顺风顺水，直到某个炎热的夏日突然遇见了一个非人之物。他决定伸出援手，人生从此急转直下！如今，有了神秘魔法力量的帮助，Neo必须协助这位新朋友。

[译自并改编自[url=https://stampaw.itch.io/when-you-are-here]Itch.io[/url]]
